messages:
maria: Quick check — CloudX just gave an ETA of Tue for incoming racks but only allocated 8 A100s. We need an extra tenant-slice for the search-service demo on Wed. Anyone able to soft-hold or swap 4 GPUs from a demo pool? Also finance flagged invoice #7842 so vendor may hold units until payment confirmed. :grimacing:

jang: Pinging procurement. @oliver any chance payments can clear fast? If not we can try borrow 4 A100s from eu-demo pool as a short-term move.

oliver: Payment is queued but finance needs PO match. I can escalate. For a temp alloc try from the infra jumpbox: `./tools/alloc --tenant search-service --gpu A100 --count 4 --until 2026-03-25`

maria: ran that, got `QuotaExceeded` response.

leo: Which quota? project or org? Try `--scope org` to check org-level slack.

maria: project-level blocked. Error: `QuotaExceeded: GPU slots (A100) remaining 0 of 12`

vendor-bot: vendor update — invoice 7842 received, pending verification (ETA 12-24h).

jang: OK. Two paths: (a) borrow 4 A100 from eu-demo (if @leo confirms availability) or (b) fallback to H100/L40 mix + quantization. Which risk is acceptable for the demo?

leo: eu-demo currently shows 6 free A100s but they're earmarked for a training smoke on 2026-03-25 04:00 UTC. I can move that job to spot and free them if needed.

maria: Can you move it? That job is low-priority smoke test.

leo: yes, I'll open a PR to shift the schedule (PR #4823). cc @oliver on billing.

oliver: Finance will approve the release if we get the PO reference on the payment. I'm chasing payments ops now.

maria: If we get the 4 A100s we still need RDMA in eu-west1. @jang can you confirm network/subnet tag?

jang: RDMA is enabled for that pool but allocations require subnet tag `redwood-ai-rdma`. Add `--subnet redwood-ai-rdma` to the alloc command.

maria: updated command: `./tools/alloc --tenant search-service --gpu A100 --count 4 --until 2026-03-25 --subnet redwood-ai-rdma` — returned `pending`.

leo: I'll watch the allocation. If it stalls > 20m I'll escalate to the vendor Slack and open a support ticket.

maria: noted. Demo doc will mention fallback: if vendor verification >36h fallback to 2x L40 (quantized) which approximates 4 A100 for the workload.

oliver: Payments ops acknowledged, verification ETA ~6h. Will post confirmation here when done.

jang: great, tagging @infra-oncall in case manual override needed on alloc.

infra-oncall: seen, standing by. :eyes:

maria: thanks everyone — I'll update status in ~30m. If allocation goes green I'll reserve demo slot and notify product.
